name: CI: Accessibility (pa11y)
description: GitHub Actions workflow that calls rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows ci-test-a11y.yml. Runs pa11y-ci WCAG2AA scans against a wp-env-booted site. Calls `@v1` by default.

inputs.description: Tag or ref of rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows to call.
Node.js version. Leave empty to use the project's .nvmrc, which the shared workflow reads.
